review_basis: §41.1, seven additions; source-date clarification sent before counts
rna_source_policy: snapshot the matching official EBI GOA RNA GAF/GPI, retaining mutable upstream URLs, headers and full hashes; do not claim those URLs are archived
taxon_rule: the first GAF taxon must equal taxon:9606
supplemental_evidence_use: separate direct gene-term counts, never primary positives
negative_annotation_use: NOT rows are excluded from positives and never become training negatives
alternate_id_policy: resolve explicit alt_id entries to active primary terms
obsolete_and_unknown_term_policy: exclude and audit; no replacement inference
aspect_mismatch_policy: exclude and audit rows whose GAF aspect differs from the resolved ontology namespace
annotation_extension_policy: retain source row context; a gene-term positive asserts evidence in at least one reported context
uniprot_mapping: exact accession to Approved HGNC uniprot_ids to explicit Ensembl stable gene IDs; HUMAN GPI retained as source metadata, no GPI/symbol fallback
rnacentral_mapping: union explicit human RNAcentral 27.0 HGNC-to-Approved-HGNC-Ensembl and ENSEMBL_GENCODE gene-ID candidates; append _9606 only from taxon=9606 mapping rows
ensembl_version_policy: only explicit ENSG identifiers with optional numeric versions are normalized to stable gene IDs
ambiguous_identifier_policy: exclude global one-to-many product-to-gene mappings before evaluation-universe or biotype filtering
evaluation_universe: GENCODE v50 protein_coding and lncRNA genes on chr1-22 and chrX
split_policy: reuse frozen label-free split and purged fitting roles; no label-driven reassignment
aspect_annotated_denominator: union of experimentally annotated evaluation-universe genes under this identical filter in that aspect, before term-size/task exclusions

panel_rule.clustering: connected components across all fully supported terms, using propagated positive sets
panel_rule.cluster_rank: decreasing component size, then lexicographically smallest GO ID
panel_rule.representative: largest propagated positive set, then lexicographically smallest GO ID
panel_rule.hierarchy_constraint: no final representative is an is_a/part_of ancestor or descendant of any development representative
panel_rule.conflicting_final_cluster_policy: skip and retain reason, then inspect next ranked cluster
panel_rule.shortage_policy: report unfilled slots and keep panel admission blocked; no fallback

lncrna_stratum: intergenic and nearest protein-coding TSS distance strictly >50000 bp, intersected with evaluation universe
metrics_required_on_future_results: per-term AP and each selector's pipeline-matched shuffled reference
lncRNA honest-stratum AP with same gate
temporal_benchmark: requires a separately pinned earlier GO release; outside this preparation milestone
next_gate: separate-code/process source/ID/ontology replay and GO-specific source-rederivation gate before scoring
